label: Untrusted
description: Submitted or externally linked; no review conclusion.

label: Metadata Reviewed
description: Required fields and declared behavior were reviewed as data.

label: Scanned
description: Configured static checks completed; not a safety guarantee.

label: Human Reviewed
description: A reviewer inspected the scoped submission and recorded evidence.

label: Verified
description: The exact referenced commit and record completed the required review process.

label: Quarantined
description: Removed from normal discovery pending a safety review.

label: Revoked
description: Previous recognition withdrawn with a preserved audit record.

label: Archived
description: Historical and no longer active; evidence remains readable.
